title: THE MARKSMAN RIFLE AND THE WHISPER ARE GONE
why: His order (2026-10-18): get rid of the Marksman Rifle and the Whisper totally. Both guns, their field items, rarity twins, drawings, sounds, recoil, loot rows, shop and kit lists, the SP ladder and the arcade lists no longer name them, with same-weight fillers in the loot tables so the roll stream and the seed 4242 counts hold. A saved one turns into its credits on load (gunsGoneSweep) and never crashes the hub.
now: The Marksman Rifle and the Whisper are gone. A saved one pays its credits when the game loads.
